REMOTE ACCESS
Use Quarters from your phone or any browser, over the internet. Devices sign in with a passkey (Face ID, Touch ID or PIN), paired from here on this Mac, or with the username and password you set below.
The HTTPS address of your tunnel (Cloudflare Tunnel or Tailscale Funnel) that forwards to the local address. Leave it empty to use http://localhost: from this Mac, or from another computer through an SSH tunnel (ssh -L 8421:localhost:8421 your-mac).
Password sign-in
Devices
Setting up the tunnel
Quarters only listens on this Mac. A tunnel gives it a public HTTPS address without opening ports on your router.
Cloudflare Tunnel (your own domain):
brew install cloudflared
cloudflared tunnel login
cloudflared tunnel create quarters
cloudflared tunnel route dns quarters quarters.example.com
cloudflared tunnel run --url http://127.0.0.1:8421 quarters
Tailscale Funnel: tailscale funnel 8421, then use the https://…ts.net address it prints.
Optional extra lock: put Cloudflare Access (email code) in front of the tunnel.
